skill_yaml:
skill: peg_channel
phases:
- id: rotate_1
  type: rotate
  generator: impedance_motion
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
- id: retract_1
  type: retract
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    retract_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.2
- id: descend_1
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: admittance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  parameters:
    depth:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
- id: pull_1
  type: pull
  generator: arc_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: time_limit
  parameters:
    pull_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.2

skill: peg_channel
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: approach_peg
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.05
  - 0.02
  weight: 0.2
- id: push_to_goal
  target_entity: object
  metric: goal_progress
  weight: 0.8
phases:
- id: approach_peg
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: peg
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    - 0.02
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: scale
  subtask_id: approach_peg
- id: push_channel
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.16
      axis: channel_axis
      mode: replace_offset_projection
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.2
      default: 0.16
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.1
      default: 0.04
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: scale
  guards:
  - id: force_limit
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 35.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.003
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: push_to_goal
